integrity: The all-field dimension result is proved using exact integer minors and explicit kernel and local witnesses; a standalone Python checker corroborates finite cases. No external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem concerns a specified five-dimensional algebra and linear local derivations only; the underlying multiplication and characteristic-zero rigidity predate this work. Older specialized full-text priority is incompletely accessible.
title: A characteristic-two local-derivation defect in a five-dimensional Zinbiel algebra
